source_visual_observations: Two horizontal parallel lines AB and CD; rising transversal through E and F; angle1 at F=50°; angle2 at E upper-left.
audit.independent_solution: The acute corresponding angle at E is50 degrees. Angle2 forms a linear pair with it, so angle2=180-50=130 degrees, choice C.
